info.title: GP247 REST API v1 (frozen)
info.description: REST API v1 of gp247/core, gp247/front and gp247/shop (prefixes api/core and api/front). Frozen since v2 shipped in 3.3.0: no new features, security fixes only; fresh installs have v1 switched off (since gp247/core 3.3.1) and a group turned off answers 404 with code api_disabled. New apps should use API v2 (openapi.json, api-introduction.md). Every error body is {"error":1,"msg":"…","code":"…"}. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header (since 3.4.0). See api-v1.md.
